title: The Scale plan is generally available | Lumenrail Blog
description: Today the Lumenrail Scale plan leaves beta and is generally available to every customer. Scale costs $349 per month billed annually ($419 billed monthly) and includes 50M events per month, 13 months of data retention and SAML SSO. Additional events are $6 per million. Customers on the Scale beta keep their beta price until their next renewal.

title: Pricing | Lumenrail
description: Lumenrail pricing. Starter: $79 per month billed annually, 5M events per month. Scale: $349 per month billed annually ($419 billed monthly), 50M events per month, SAML SSO, 13-month retention. Enterprise: custom pricing and volume. Extra events on Scale cost $6 per million.

title: Introducing the Scale plan (beta) | Lumenrail Blog
description: We're opening a beta of our new Scale plan for high-volume teams. During the beta, Scale is $299 per month and includes 25M events per month. Pricing will change at general availability.

title: Plans and pricing | Lumenwise

title: Lumenrail takes its Scale plan out of beta
description: Product analytics startup Lumenrail made its Scale plan generally available this week. The company did not comment on how many customers joined the beta, which launched last November.
